entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Isn't the man sitting over there one of[n]them?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: He's the president of a TV station,[n]isn't he?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: He gives letters of introduction to[n]executives of companies who are[n]willing to sponsor his programs.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That's a difficult condition to meet...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wanna just beat it outta him?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Let me handle this.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: For real? But...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'll allow it. You've got this, Noir.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Yes, Senpai!

entries.speaker: Shadow TV President
entries.en: A letter of introduction? But you're so[n]obviously a child.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I am Haru Okumura, daughter of the[n]president of Okumura Foods. I believe[n]we sponsored you as well.

entries.speaker: Shadow TV President
entries.en: Oh, you're her?

entries.speaker: Shadow TV President
entries.en: It's true that I'm quite indebted to[n]President Okumura. He funded us[n]extremely well, after all.

entries.speaker: Shadow TV President
entries.en: However, it looks like he got a little[n]carried away. My condolences.

entries.speaker: Shadow TV President
entries.en: Regarding his exploiting management...[n]Mr. Shido asked me to defend him as[n]much as I could.

entries.speaker: Shadow TV President
entries.en: I even threw some extra security his way,[n]but there were limits to what I could do.

entries.speaker: Shadow TV President
entries.en: The damage almost reached up to[n]Mr. Shido himself. President Okumura[n]had to be cut off.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Cut off...

entries.speaker: Shadow TV President
entries.en: It seems he didn't just cast him off his[n]ship, but also used him to trap the[n]Phantom Thieves.

entries.speaker: Shadow TV President
entries.en: Bravo, Mr. Shido. Truly a nasty maneuver.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: ...Won't you please give me a letter[n]of recommendation?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Once our company recovers, I will[n]arrange for us to cooperate with you[n]in a sponsorship role.

entries.speaker: Shadow TV President
entries.en: You're the daughter of the late president.[n]Do you really have the authority to do[n]that?

entries.speaker: Shadow TV President
entries.en: Your employees probably resent you...

entries.speaker: Shadow TV President
entries.en: ...Well, that's not important.

entries.speaker: Shadow TV President
entries.en: I'm in your father's debt, after all. I can[n]repay some kindness to his daughter.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Thank you... very much...

entries.speaker: Shadow TV President
entries.en: But my, your father truly was a fool.

entries.speaker: Shadow TV President
entries.en: He could've lived a life of luxury if only[n]he'd done what he was told.

entries.speaker: Shadow TV President
entries.en: You know, I'm the one who broadcast[n]the moment of his mental shutdown.

entries.speaker: Shadow TV President
entries.en: Our ratings shot up 'cause of that!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: ...Stop it.

entries.speaker: Shadow TV President
entries.en: Hmm?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: How could you talk about my father's[n]death like that?

entries.speaker: Shadow TV President
entries.en: Hm? That's just business.

entries.speaker: Shadow TV President
entries.en: If you like, we could get you in a[n]documentary. "Overcoming death[n]to rebuild a family company"...

entries.speaker: Shadow TV President
entries.en: You're so cute you might just get good[n]ratings.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I will not forgive you for that! You had[n]better apologize to my father!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Time to save her!

entries.speaker: Shadow TV President
entries.en: Are you... thieves!?
